gate_scope: documentation and receipt only; no DEEP Observer behaviour rewrite
primary_truth_lit_rule: Every Hearthfire surface should glow because something is true.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: The central glyph translates direct readings and model variables into visible structure, motion, edge activity, rings, and centre glow.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: The glyph is a teaching instrument. It makes current observation state easier to inspect, not a proof of hidden states.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: The outer sensor nodes name the readings the instrument says it receives: time, moon, Kp, Bz, source, local, motion, and touch.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Sensor jewels should glow or respond only to show declared direct readings and user interaction paths.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Pulse paths show how a selected direct input travels into visible instrument behaviour.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Motion makes translation inspectable rather than ornamental.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: The meters display the current readable values used by the instrument.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Meter changes should represent declared observation or fallback values.

visual_receipts.state_source: user-enabled sound field and displayed packet
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Sound is generated locally after activation and maps the displayed packet into layered sound.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Audio must remain consent-first and must not change the underlying reading.

visual_receipts.state_source: copy and save local packet actions
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Packet export is local unless the user copies or saves it.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Export controls reveal the boundary between browser state and user-directed persistence.
